metadata.description: Copilot CLI plugins for worktree isolation, service lifecycle, inter-agent communication, GitHub Codespaces management, local container fleets, MCP bridging, session logging, context-window handoff, effort planning, coordinator-first delegation, publication safety, WSL environment setup, and CLI customization

plugins.name: agent-worktrees
plugins.description: Worktree isolation system for concurrent Copilot CLI sessions - lifecycle management, finalization, cleanup, service discovery, and deployment patterns for monorepos

plugins.name: agent-bridge
plugins.description: Persistent inter-agent communication service - session management, SSE event streaming, agent subprocess spawning, and an ACP-over-WebSocket transport (+ built-in status UX) for external ACP clients like acp-ui

plugins.name: agent-codespaces
plugins.description: GitHub Codespaces lifecycle management, SSH transport, credential relay, and agent-bridge provider integration

plugins.name: agent-containers
plugins.description: Local Docker dev-container fleet management, lease broker, and agent-bridge container: namespace resolver with trusted-fleet OpenSSH transport

plugins.name: agent-mcp
plugins.description: Swiss-army MCP bridge - wrap an upstream MCP server (HTTP or stdio) as a local stdio MCP, inject host credentials, and apply a decorator stack (filter, rename, defer, code-mode, storage, transform, gate). Dual-era: speaks modern MCP 2.x (2026-07-28) and the legacy handshake, in both directions.

plugins.name: agent-ssh
plugins.description: SSH connectivity layer for the agent fabric: emit and verify machine-name SSH profiles from a normalized registry, and define the public transport-provider contract for pluggable direct or tunnel transports.

plugins.name: agent-logger
plugins.description: Reusable Copilot CLI session logging - segment sessions into digestible chunks, write Markdown session logs, sync raw sessions to a configurable target, and optionally run a scheduled orchestrator that crunches a backlog into committed logs

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Context window monitoring and session handoff - a Copilot CLI session extension that tracks token utilization, stores handoffs as worktree-pinned agent-dispatch tasks when available or one-time worktree-state files otherwise, and performs successor-consume-driven live cutover so the predecessor is retired only after pickup

plugins.name: efforts
plugins.description: Efforts planning system - comprehensive planning folders with explicit repository adoption, a read-only target capability probe, a README-as-shared-contract, a static completion-gate fallback, and a staged session policy producer; ships the planning-efforts and efforts-setup skills

plugins.name: visions
plugins.description: Visions system - persistent, in-place-revised north-star documents stating what a system/service/tool/product is ultimately meant to be (purpose + concepts + expected features + expected behaviors); intent-level, not a specification; efforts are carved from the vision-vs-reality delta. Ships the envisioning and visions-setup skills

plugins.name: customizing-copilot
plugins.description: Customize and extend the Copilot CLI - authoring skills, defining sub-agents, registering MCP servers, installing plugins, building an agent control-harness, reviewing customizations, and authoring <repo>-harness plugins - with the per-skill folder conventions and Agent Skills best practices; ships the authoring-skills, defining-subagents, registering-mcp-servers, installing-plugins, building-harnesses, reviewing-customizations, and authoring-harness-plugins skills

plugins.name: agent-dispatch
plugins.description: Portable agent task-queue + per-host coordinator: a single-writer SQLite work queue (eight-state model with owner-preserving suspension, capability-gated atomic claim, affinity routing, liveness-reconciled recovery) so agents coordinate without push latency or an account per agent.

plugins.name: agent-vault
plugins.description: Local KeePassXC-backed secret store for Copilot CLI agents. A machine-local service caches the KeePass master password with a TTL and auto-prompts on lock; a CLI fetches API keys, SSH keys, and account credentials on demand and manages entries (get/has/search/list/show/add/set-password/set-username/remove/move/import-key/export-key) without hardcoding, committing, or exporting them. Destructive edits are scoped to the configured vault group unless forced. Includes a SUDO_ASKPASS helper for sudo -A, a git-credential helper that delegates allowlisted HTTPS hosts to Git Credential Manager, an envelope-KEK seal/unseal facility (DPAPI-wrapped on Windows) for encrypting a consumer's own token cache at rest, and an opt-in encrypted persistent cache that serves reads across restarts and while the vault is locked.

plugins.name: copilot-extensions-harness
plugins.description: Operator harness for the copilot-extensions repo - portable contribution, diagnosis, deployment, and clean-room validation guidance plus an ambient pointer to the general-purpose, organization-neutral contribution boundary.

plugins.name: wsl-setup
plugins.description: Set up and troubleshoot WSL2 as a first-class development and service-hosting environment - install a distro, choose the networking mode (NAT + localhostForwarding vs mirrored + dnsTunneling), split storage across a small NTFS-hosted rootfs VHD and a native ext4 data disk, keep the distro alive for hosted services, and diagnose corp-network egress and host<->WSL loopback failures. Composes with agent-worktrees' agent-worktrees-wsl-provision; ships the setting-up-wsl, splitting-wsl-storage and troubleshooting-wsl-networking skills

plugins.name: agent-index
plugins.description: Portable indexing and semantic-search engine for a harness repo and its immediate ecosystem, with good-citizen ingestion.

plugins.name: agent-machines
plugins.description: Portable restore-machinestate for Copilot CLI - converge the current machine to desired state declared in in-repo requirement packages (Copilot settings first, then repo-local modules). Machine-scoped union restore discovered from the adopted-projects registry, a seven-disposition model (enforce/ensure-present/capture-only/ignore/exclude/prune/prerequisite-check), a conflict validator that detects (never auto-arbitrates) cross-package clashes, and a repo-local module runner (dry-run-aware, gated, cross-platform) so sensitive OS-mutating modules stay in each harness repo while the engine stays generic.

plugins.name: harness-knowledge
plugins.description: Binds a stateless Copilot CLI control harness to its private knowledge repo, harness-first: after cloning the harness, ask for (or create) the knowledge repo, register both, and write the machine-local knowledge_repo pointer so agent-worktrees can resolve state and paired worktrees natively. Ships the binding-knowledge setup skill.

plugins.name: ai-attribution
plugins.description: Ambient publication and AI-attribution safety for git repositories, with portable operator policy, host-qualified local remote hints, an idempotent setup skill, and an on-demand publication workflow. Payload-only: dependency-free Bash and PowerShell session-start hooks plus skills.

plugins.name: delegation-guidance
plugins.description: Coordinator-first task routing for Copilot CLI. A concise session-start kernel encourages early delegation of broad separable research, comparisons, evaluations, domain-tool work, and disjoint bulk edits while keeping synthesis, integration, cohesive implementation, and completion with the coordinating agent. Ships the delegating-work skill.
